subject: Physics
q: A uniform rod of mass 4m and length l is pivoted about its centre. A particle of mass m, moving with speed v at an angle π/4 to the rod's long axis, collides with one end of the rod and sticks to it. What is the angular speed of the combined system immediately after the collision?
hint: Conserve angular momentum about the pivot; only the velocity component perpendicular to the rod contributes.
solution: Before impact, the angular momentum about the pivot is $L_i=mv(l/2)\sin(\pi/4)=mvl/(2\sqrt{2})$. After impact, $I=(4ml^2/12)+m(l/2)^2=7ml^2/12$. Therefore $\omega=L_i/I=3\sqrt{2}v/(7l)$.
